title: [P] Requires win32gui module, which may not be present by default
description:
Using vanilla win 10 VM, python.org 3.5.3, and java jdk 1.8.

Attempting install with no versions specified (thus gets latest) gives an error "No module named 'win32gui'
Workaround is to pip install pywin32

Need to either pull this module in if required or find another way to send broadcast message for the environment variable change.

title: [P] spark_install uses cdh4 as default
description:
Run `spark_install(spark_version = "1.6.2")`, currently `CDH4` is installed; however, latest Hadoop version should be preffered.

See: https://github.com/rstudio/spark-install/blob/master/R/R/versions.R#L121-L125
